layout: Legacy F1 2019 Hockenheim Grand Prix layout as represented in F1 2020 footage; use blue/white kerbs shown.
sector_registration: All stations in retained native origin. Approximate full-route zones; individual decor must stay beyond verified protection and runoff.

sectors.name: Main straight and Nordkurve
sectors.observed_environment: Motodrom main stand has red seats and repeated swooping/cantilever roof bays; pits opposite have deep overhang and narrow upper glass band. Blue/white edge kerbs and blue outer apron.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Einlauf and short approach
sectors.observed_environment: Short grass verges, close catch fence and low service buildings. Wide corner-specific escape apron, forest horizon; no city skyline.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Parabolika and Spitzkehre
sectors.observed_environment: Long broad left-curving straight through flat grass with tall forest in distance. Blue/white kerbs; hairpin has large paved/gravel braking escape and limited structures.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Mercedes Arena
sectors.observed_environment: Open arena approach with grassy interior, low white race facilities, Mercedes circular/cylinder control-building form and tall water-tower-like support structure. Temporary/open stands frame the tight turn group.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Mobil1 and Sachs stadium entry
sectors.observed_environment: Motodrom enclosing curved grandstand bowl, white/gray control structures and banked Sachs bend. Blue outside apron, gravel trap and blue/white kerbs; not a flat fenced road.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Südkurve and pit return
sectors.observed_environment: Continuous curved outer grandstands, roof piers/canopies and broad stadium grass/gravel. Final linked corners lead into pit straight, with blue painted outer edges and close white walls.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.
